title: AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload

allOf.description: Specifies the number of days after which Amazon S3 aborts an incomplete multipart upload.

description: Specifies the days since the initiation of an incomplete multipart upload that Amazon S3 will wait before permanently removing all parts of the upload. For more information, see Aborting Incomplete Multipart Uploads Using a Bucket Lifecycle Policy in the Amazon S3 User Guide.
